title: Linking the Parts of an Essay
goal: Link the parts of an essay with the right marker at each turn.
grammar: Linking the Parts of an Essay

items: I can move an essay forward with *llegados a este punto* and *en suma*.
I can choose the right marker to add, limit, draw a consequence or close.
I can plan the parts of a short essay.
